prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "body": "Select standard adoption for instant preset companions or custom photo upload for tailored pets."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Log in with your existing account to keep your saved pets."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_account_sync_check", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Style Selection Flow: Add a pet style selector screen (new_pet_style_picker) before uploading photos to set clear aesthetic expectations for generated custom pets.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Photo & Select Art Style", "hint": "Ensure clear lighting and single subject photos for best custom pet generation results."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_style_picker", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Interaction Shortcuts Checklist: Redesign the home_intro screen into a checklist layout displaying core desktop shortcuts and pet control actions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "body": "Review these essential controls to interact with, position, or hide your pet anytime.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "label": "Press Alt+P to show/hide pet on screen", "style": "rounded"}]}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Already created a pet? Sign in with your original account method to restore your companion."}}
5: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Name Editability Reassurance: Update the adoption certificate copy to inform users that pet names and personality traits can be modified later in settings.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Give your new pet a name. You can edit names, outfits, and traits anytime later in desktop settings.", "hint": "Click confirm to finish registering your desktop companion."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Display Guidance Wait Info: Add desktop screen permissions and window overlay troubleshooting tips to the waiting screen while rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Rendering Desktop Pet Model", "hint": "Make sure desktop window transparency permissions are granted. Your pet will drop onto your screen shortly.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 6}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Story Scroll Layout: Switch story screen layout to story_scroll to present the pet companion narrative smoothly.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Discover how a virtual companion lives on your desktop screen while you work and play."}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Companion Starter Pack Adoption Incentive: Add a starter accessory pack reward badge to the pet selection screen.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Select Your First Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Free Starter Accessory Pack", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [home, new_screen] Desktop Display Compatibility Verification Screen: Add a new desktop display test screen (new_desktop_display_test) right after rendering to confirm the pet is visible on user's primary monitor.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_display_test", "home_intro"]}
